FrontendUrl.description: The frontend URL used to determine absolute inbound URLs for redirects shown in the Umbraco backoffice.

RedirectsDashboardSettings.description: Configuration for the global redirects dashboard.

Enabled.description: Whether the redirects dashboard is enabled.

Weight.description: The weight of the redirects dashboard.

PageSize.description: The number of redirects shown per page in the dashboard.

Debounce.description: The debounce time in milliseconds for the dashboard.

UserGroups.description: The user groups for which the redirects dashboard should be shown or hidden.

RedirectsDocumentWorkspaceViewSettings.description: Configuration for the redirects workspace view shown for documents.

Enabled.description: Whether the redirects workspace view for documents is enabled.

Weight.description: The weight of the redirects workspace view for documents.

RequireTemplate.description: Whether the document must have a template assigned for the redirects workspace view to be shown.

UserGroups.description: The user groups for which the redirects workspace view for documents should be shown.

ContentTypes.description: The content types for which the redirects workspace view for documents should be shown.

RedirectsMediaWorkspaceViewSettings.description: Configuration for the redirects workspace view shown for media.

Enabled.description: Whether the redirects workspace view for media is enabled.

Weight.description: The weight of the redirects workspace view for media.

UserGroups.description: The user groups for which the redirects workspace view for media should be shown.

MediaTypes.description: The media types for which the redirects workspace view for media should be shown.
